dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "I did what?! Can't remember shit, I was wasted."
dialogueTree.polish: „Że co zrobiłem? Ni cholery nic nie pamiętam, byłem porobiony”.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Што я зрабіў?! Ні хера не памятаю, у гаўно быў".

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Aye', cut that shit out, man."
dialogueTree.polish: „E, uspokój się, typie”.

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Gimme another one!"
dialogueTree.polish: „Jeszcze jedną kolejkę!”

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Hey, don't be going soft on me."
dialogueTree.polish: „Ejże, nie wymiękaj mi tutaj”.

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Tell it like it's told, man. Tell it straight."
dialogueTree.polish: „Nie owijaj w bawełnę, stary. Mów wprost”.

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "No way I'm going back to Jamrock."
dialogueTree.polish: „Mowy nie ma, żebym wrócił do Jamrock”.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Ні за што не вярнуся ў Джэмрок".

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "If it's titties, then Monica's!"
dialogueTree.polish: „Jak cycki, to Moniki!”

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "... no worse than the bangers on Boogie Street."
dialogueTree.polish: „...nie gorsi od gangusów z Boogie Street”.

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "*This* is gonna make a hell of a sad tattoo..."
dialogueTree.polish: „*To* będzie piekielnie smutny tatuaż...”

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Theo went like he lived -- fast and hard. Tough old man."
dialogueTree.polish: „Theo zginął tak, jak żył. Szybko i z jebnięciem. Stary twardziel”.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Тэа пайшоў так, як і жыў — хутка і жорстка. Моцны стары".

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "The Hardie boys are *unfuckable* now."
dialogueTree.polish: „Chłopaki Hardiego są teraz *nie do zajebania*”.

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "We could take over the entire city."
dialogueTree.polish: „Moglibyśmy przejąć całe miasto”.

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Like a fucking *cobarde*... bitchman-Alain, shit..."
dialogueTree.polish: „Jak jebany *cobarde*... Alainowa dziwka, kurwa...”

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Survivor guilt my ass, *I* wanted to go that way!"
dialogueTree.polish: „Gówno, a nie poczucie winy ocalałego. To *ja* chciałem iść w tamtą stronę!”
dialogueTree.belarusian: "У дупу пачуццё віны ацалелага, гэта *я* хацеў так пайсці!"

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Shame... (hic) burns worse than fire, man..."
dialogueTree.polish: „Wstyd... *czk*... pali gorzej niż ogień, stary...”

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "I'm the lucky fuck, who didn't take a scratch." (Sighs.)
dialogueTree.polish: „Jestem fartowny skurwiel, którego nawet nie tknęli” – mówi, wzdychając.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Я той фартовы хуй, на якім ні драпіны". (Уздыхае.)

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Ain't no one gonna be riding any ballads about me..."
dialogueTree.polish: „O mnie nikt ballad wyśpiewywał nie będzie...”
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Ніхто не будзе скакаць ніякіх балад пра мяне..."

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Shanky's gonna get a lesson in Boogie Street justice."
dialogueTree.polish: „Kosior dostanie lekcję sprawiedliwości rodem z Boogie Street”.

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Gonna hunt that rat-faced fuck down."
dialogueTree.polish: „Muszę dorwać tego skurwiałego szczura”.

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "For Titus... for Glenny... for... for Titus!!!"
dialogueTree.polish: „Za Titusa... za Glenny'ego... Za... za Titusa!!!”
dialogueTree.belarusian: "За Цітуса... за Глені... за... за Цітуса!!!"

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "When it's done I'll just blow my brains out... Fuck everything."
dialogueTree.polish: „Jak to się skończy, to se po prostu odstrzelę łeb... Jebać to wszystko”.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Калі ўсё скончыцца, я проста вынесу сабе мазгі... Пайшло яно ўсё да хера".

dialogueTree.speaker: Alain -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Boogie street justice. Gonna make you proud, T."
dialogueTree.polish: „Sprawiedliwość rodem z Boogie Street. Będziesz ze mnie dumny, T”.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Правасуддзе Бугі-стрыт. Ты будзеш ганарыцца мной, Т".
